ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the one who got away

plain.li: [person] {NAME} was standing at the gate in the dream, just standing, and the others walked past without looking.
[person] The fight again, and this time {NAME} turned at the edge of the trees and smiled at me.
[person,kin] Dreamt {NAME} came to the funeral and stood at the back, and I couldn't make my legs move.
[beast] Something big moved in the dark at the edge of the fields all night in my dream. I knew it was {NAME}.
[beast] {NAME} was breathing under the floor all night, slow and patient.

warm.li: Dreamt {NAME} came back, and everyone I love stood between us without being asked.

blunt.li: {NAME}, all night. My hands are still fists.

gloomy.li: {NAME} is out there. In the dream, {NAME} was in here.

cold.li: {NAME} at the gate, in the dream. I'm taking it as practice.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of standing my ground

plain.li: [person] In the dream {NAME} came at me and I didn't step back, and we stood there nose to nose until the dream ran out.
[person] Dreamt I found {NAME} asleep by a fire, and stood there a long time deciding.
[beast] I followed {NAME}'s tracks through the snow until they ended in my own footprints.
[kin] I told {NAME} the name of the one {NAME} killed, in the dream, and made {NAME} say it back.

blunt.li: Faced {NAME} last night. In a dream, but I didn't run.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I chased {NAME} clean off the map, shouting. Very satisfying.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I faced {NAME}, and it didn't end. It just went on.

cold.li: A dream of the next encounter with {NAME}. I took notes on my footing.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the locked door

plain.li: Went down to the cells, and {NAME}'s door was open, and the room inside was full of my own things.
In the dream {NAME} talked to me through the wall all night in a voice I'd never heard {NAME} use.
I held the key to {NAME}'s cell, and it got heavier every hour, and I couldn't put it down.

warm.li: Dreamt I brought {NAME} a bowl of soup and we said nothing, and that was the end of something.

blunt.li: Dreamt of {NAME} in the cells. The lock's fine. I checked.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {NAME} was the free one and I was in the cell, and the others brought {NAME} my supper.

cold.li: A dream about the prisoner. The lock held, as locks do.

plain.li: Dreamt of {NAME}, and felt nothing at all. I slept the rest of the night like a stone.
In the dream I walked the place where it happened, and it was just a field, with flowers in it.
[beast] I walked under the trees where {NAME} used to wait, and only birds came out of them.
[kin] Dreamt the one {NAME} took from us came and sat by my bed and said it was all right now.

warm.li: Dreamt of the ones who stood with me against {NAME}, out in the yard, laughing about something else entirely.

blunt.li: {NAME} was in my dream and I didn't care. Good.

cheerful.li: Dreamt {NAME} was a very small dog. I've decided that's how I'll remember it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt it was over. It is. I keep needing to be told.

cold.li: A dream about {NAME}, emotionally flat. The matter is closed.
